1.Detail: Drat! A chef has set fire to the kitchen! Help him put out the fire!

2.Detail: The Master Chefs have awoken a hibernating grizzly bear while foraging for ingredients! Go to their aid!

3.Detail: There's not enough firewood for the kitchens. Help cut down more wood for the kitchen.

4.Detail: The Master Chefs have become trapped by heavy snow. Go and rescue them from their plight.

5.Detail: The kitchen is understaffed. Lend them a helping hand.

6.Detail: One of the chefs fell asleep and burned all of his dishes. Help him to salvage the situation!

7.Detail: One of the Master Chefs fell into the sea while fishing! Jump in and help them out!

8.Detail: The food in the kitchen has attracted many rats. Deal with the rats and save the food.

9.Detail: One of the bakers has injured themselves. Help out until they have recovered.

10.Detail: The king will be attending the feast! Appropriate decorations must be made to the banquet hall! Lend a hand with the decorations.

11.Detail: One of the ovens has broken. Help the chefs fix it quickly!

12.Detail: The Master Chefs have fallen into a hunter's trap while out foraging. Save them!

13.Detail: One of the cows the Master Chefs were milking has become enraged! Help them tame the beast.

14.Detail: The food cart has been damaged on its way to the banquet hall. Help repair the cart.

15.Detail: The Master Chefs have disturbed a beehive! Help them deal with the angry bees.

16.Detail: A careless chef has misplaced one of his special recipes. Help him look for the lost recipe.

17.Detail: The Master Chefs have discovered an ancient recipe but are having a hard time deciphering its text. Help them decipher its meaning!

18.Detail: The Master Chefs have become stuck in a fetid swamp. Help extricate them from the mud's sticky grasp.

19.Detail: Another accident has occurred in the kitchen! Flour has fallen all over the floor. Help the chefs sweep up the mess.

20.Detail: Deliver banquet invitations to the nearby locals or all the food will go to waste!

21.Detail: The Master Chefs need a guide to guide them around The Ancient Ruins. Help them by leading the way!

22.Detail: Dragon hens are extremely fast. Help the Master Chefs catch one!
